rules.noGameYet: No game has been configured yet. Rules will be available once a game is set up.
rules.killDeadlineInfoSuffix: hours to eliminate your target before the chain moves on.
rules.step1Desc: Join the game during the sign-up period. Once the game starts, you receive a random target and a random prop.
rules.step2Desc: Check your dashboard to see who your target is. You'll find their name and profile photo there.
rules.step3Desc: You must use your randomly assigned prop during the elimination. It must clearly appear in your evidence photo.
rules.step4Desc: Take a photo of yourself with your target and prop, then submit it via the 'Submit Kill' button — before your kill deadline expires.
rules.step5Desc: A lecturer reviews your photo. Once approved, the kill appears in the Kill Feed and you receive a new target. Last one standing wins!
rules.rule1: Eliminations must take place on campus or at official school activities.
rules.rule2: No physical contact allowed — the game is entirely photo-based.
rules.rule3: You cannot target someone who is already eliminated or has a pending review.
rules.rule4: Unsportsmanlike behaviour or misuse can result in disqualification.

hero.sub: Everything you need to get started: the five most important platforms in one place.

intranet.name: KdG Intranet
intranet.desc: The intranet is KdG's digital hub. Find news, announcements and direct links to all other platforms here. It's the place you open every day.
intranet.f1: Current news and announcements from the school
intranet.f2: Direct links to Canvas, TimeEdit and eStudentService
intranet.f3: Documents and messages from the programme

canvas.name: Canvas
canvas.desc: Canvas is the heart of your programme. All course content, assignments, deadlines and lecturer feedback are here. Check Canvas daily.
canvas.f1: Course material and slides per subject
canvas.f3: Calendar with deadlines and exam moments

timeedit.name: TimeEdit
timeedit.desc: TimeEdit shows your personal class schedule and lets you reserve available rooms. Perfect for group work, self-study sessions or a quiet workspace between classes.
timeedit.f1: View and export your personal timetable

estudentservice.name: eStudentService
estudentservice.desc: eStudentService is your personal student file at KdG. Manage your enrolment, track your results and request official documents here.
estudentservice.f1: Grades and study results per course unit
estudentservice.f2: View enrolment contract and registration confirmation
estudentservice.f3: Request certificates: public transport, student status, ...
estudentservice.f4: Full overview of your study programme and ECTS credits

ects.name: ECTS Sheets
ects.desc: ECTS sheets describe each course unit in detail: what you learn, how you are assessed, and how many study points the course is worth. Essential for your study planning.
ects.f1: Look up learning objectives and content per subject
ects.f2: View assessment methods and exam regulations
ects.f3: Check study points (ECTS) per course unit

tip.label: Pro tip
tip.body: Set the intranet as your browser's homepage. From there you always have quick access to Canvas, TimeEdit and eStudentService — without ever having to remember a link.

gotcha.title: Ready for Gotcha?
gotcha.desc: It's time for the ultimate campus game. This banner leads you to your dashboard where you can see your target and track your eliminations. Click the banner now to join the game!
gotcha.targetDesc: This is the person you need to 'eliminate'. You also see which item you must use.
gotcha.timerDesc: Eliminate your target before time runs out, or you will be eliminated yourself!
gotcha.tabsDesc: Switch between the rules, the live killfeed, and (for teachers) the review panel.
gotcha.submitDesc: Successfully eliminated your target? Upload a photo here as proof.
gotcha.reviewDesc: As a teacher, you decide here if a kill is valid or should be rejected.
gotcha.rulesInfoDesc: Here you see the prize and how long you have per kill before the chain moves on.
gotcha.rulesStepsDesc: Five steps that explain the game from sign-up to winning. Read these before you start!
gotcha.rulesImportantDesc: These are the boundaries of the game. Violating them can result in disqualification.
gotcha.feedDesc: Every approved elimination appears here in real time. You can like kills too!
gotcha.feedEmptyDesc: No kills yet — the game just started. Check back soon!
gotcha.reviewActionsDesc: Swipe or use the buttons to approve a valid kill or deny a fraudulent one.
gotcha.reviewEmptyDesc: All pending kills have been reviewed. Nothing left to do here for now!

mod.headerDesc: Welcome to the control room. Here you keep the community safe and friendly.
mod.filtersDesc: Filter by report type or channel to find exactly what needs your attention.
mod.openDesc: These items need a pair of eyes. Click 'Resolve' to see the details and take action.
mod.noOpenDesc: Currently no open reports. Great job! This is exactly how we like our dashboard.
mod.closedDesc: Here you'll find the history of resolved cases. A true hall of fame for a moderator!

avatar.kudosDesc: These are your achievements! In the avatar shop, you don't spend them; you just need to have enough to unlock items. Your balance stays the same!
avatar.previewDesc: See your changes in real-time. Once you're happy, hit the button to update your profile picture everywhere.
avatar.shopDesc: Browse through different categories. If you have enough Kudos, you can unlock and equip new styles instantly.

about.heroDesc: Welcome to the overview of all essential KdG tools. Everything you need for your studies, all in one place.
about.countersDesc: Use these shortcuts to jump directly to a specific application's details.
about.appsDesc: Each section explains what the tool is for, its key features, and provides a direct link to open it.

reportDetail.bannerDesc: Here you can see exactly why this award was flagged and what the reporter had to say.
reportDetail.contentDesc: Check the points, the reason given by the sender, and who the involved parties are.
reportDetail.actionDesc: Once you've made a decision, use this button to mark the report as handled.

gotchaEnd.winnerDesc: This player outlasted everyone. Check their kill count and claim to fame.
gotchaEnd.prizeDesc: This is what the winner takes home. Was it worth the hunt?
gotchaEnd.awardsDesc: Special achievements handed out to standout players — from fastest kill to most unlucky victim.
gotchaEnd.graphDesc: Every elimination visualised. Click a node to see someone's kills, or click an arrow for kill details.

profile.pictureDesc: This is how other students see you across the platform — in the kill feed, awards, and leaderboards.
profile.actionsDesc: Upload a new photo or remove your current one. Your avatar can also be set as your profile picture from the avatar page.
profile.infoDesc: Your name, Kudos balance and student ID. Kudos are earned by attending classes and receiving awards from teammates.

kudoOverview.reportDescNoBtn: Awards sent by teammates can be reported if they feel inappropriate. The flag icon appears on any award entry in your timeline.
kudoOverview.statsDesc: An overview of all the Kudos you've earned. Click the header to expand or collapse this panel.
kudoOverview.summaryDesc: Your total Kudos balance and your current archetype — determined by which category you score highest in.
kudoOverview.barsDesc: See exactly how your Kudos are distributed across Knowledge, Attendance, Teamwork, Atmosphere and Engagement.
kudoOverview.timelineDesc: A chronological feed of every Kudo you've received. Click the header to expand this panel.
kudoOverview.entryDesc: Each entry shows the type, date, reason and how many points it was worth. Awards from teammates also show who sent it.
kudoOverview.reportDesc: If you received an award that feels inappropriate or was sent in bad faith, use this flag to report it to a moderator.
kudoOverview.emptyDesc: You haven't received any Kudos yet. Attend classes and collaborate with teammates to start earning points!

gotchaSettings.prizeDesc2Desc: Enter the prize description in both English and Dutch — the platform is bilingual so both fields are required.
gotchaSettings.gameCardDesc: Configure the start date, kill deadline and prize for this tournament. Changes are saved per field.
gotchaSettings.gameCardLocked: The game is currently active so these settings are locked. You can still update the prize info.
gotchaSettings.startDateDesc: When does the game kick off? Players can sign up until this moment. Once started, targets are assigned automatically.
gotchaSettings.deadlineDesc: How many hours a player has to eliminate their target before the chain moves on to the next hunter.
gotchaSettings.prizeDesc: Upload a photo of the prize and add a description in both English and Dutch. Players will see this in the rules tab.
gotchaSettings.propsDesc: Props are the items players must use during their elimination. Each player gets one assigned randomly at game start.
gotchaSettings.propRowDesc: Each prop has an English and Dutch name. Use the pencil to edit or the bin to delete — only possible before the game starts.
gotchaSettings.noPropsDesc: You need at least one prop before the game can start. Add some using the button above.
gotchaSettings.addPropDesc: Click here to add a new prop. Fill in both the English and Dutch name and confirm to save it.

eventDetail.photoDesc: The cover image and category of this event. Categories help you quickly find the type of activity you're looking for.
eventDetail.infoDesc: Title, date and description of the event. Everything you need to decide if you want to join.
eventDetail.reportDesc: If this event violates community guidelines — inappropriate content, misleading info, or anything else — use this flag to notify a moderator.
eventDetail.actionDesc: Use this button to register your attendance. You can cancel later if your plans change.
eventDetail.chatDesc: Talk directly with other attendees. Ask questions, coordinate meetups, or just get hyped together!
eventDetail.chatLockedDesc: Once you join this event, a chat opens up where you can talk with all other attendees.
eventDetail.attendeesDesc: A list of everyone attending. The star icon marks the organizer. You can see how many spots are left if there's a maximum.

gotchaHistory.headerDesc: An overview of all finished Gotcha tournaments. See who came out on top in previous games.
gotchaHistory.gridDesc: Each card represents one finished tournament. Click any card to view the full results.
gotchaHistory.cardDesc: A quick summary of the game: when it was played, who won, and how many players took part.
gotchaHistory.winnerDesc: The last player standing in that tournament, along with their total kill count.
gotchaHistory.statsDesc: At a glance: total participants, total kills made, and when the game started.
gotchaHistory.viewDesc: Click anywhere on the card to open the detailed end screen for that game.
gotchaHistory.emptyDesc: No finished games yet. Once a tournament wraps up, it will appear here.

reportMessage.chatDesc: Review the conversation history to understand the context of the reported message.
reportMessage.flaggedDesc: The specific message that was reported is highlighted and marked with a flag.

reportEvent.photoDesc: Check the uploaded image and category to see if they follow the community guidelines.
reportEvent.detailsDesc: Review the title, organizer, and visibility settings of this event.
reportEvent.attendeesDesc: Here you can see everyone who registered for this event.

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Guess the hidden equation in 6 tries. Each guess must be a mathematically correct equation.

correct.label: Correct position
correct.desc: The character is in the equation and in the right spot.

present.label: Wrong position
present.desc: The character is in the equation but in the wrong spot.

absent.label: Not in the equation
absent.desc: The character is not in the equation at all.

rules.1: Every guess must be a valid equation (e.g. 10+5=15).
rules.2: The equation must contain exactly one = sign.
rules.3: The right-hand side must be a plain integer.
rules.4: No leading zeros (e.g. 01 is not allowed).
rules.5: A new puzzle is available every day.
rules.title: Rules

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Reveal all safe cells without hitting a mine. Use the numbers to figure out where mines are hiding.

hidden.label: Hidden cell
hidden.desc: Click to reveal. Right-click to place a flag.

number.label: Number
number.desc: Shows how many mines are adjacent to that cell.

flag.label: Flag
flag.desc: Mark a cell you suspect hides a mine.

mine.label: Mine
mine.desc: Click on one and the game is over.

chord.label: Chord click
chord.desc: Click a revealed number whose neighbours are all flagged to automatically reveal the remaining hidden neighbours.

rules.2: Click to reveal a cell. Empty cells cascade automatically.
rules.3: Right-click (or switch to flag mode) to mark a suspected mine.
rules.4: Reveal all safe cells to win and earn kudos!
rules.5: Chord: click a number whose surrounding flag count matches it to auto-reveal the rest.

toolbar.selectCell: Select a cell, then type a number

howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.intro: Fill the 9×9 grid so every row, column and 3×3 box contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.

given.label: Given digits
given.desc: Bold digits are pre-filled and cannot be changed.

empty.label: Empty cells
empty.desc: Click an empty cell to select it, then type a digit (1–9) to fill it in.

filled.label: Your digit
filled.desc: Digits you have entered. Press Delete or Backspace to clear a cell.

conflict.label: Conflict
conflict.desc: A red cell violates a row, column or box rule. Fix it to solve the puzzle.

selected.label: Selected cell
selected.desc: The highlighted cell is currently selected. All matching digits are also highlighted.

rules.1: Each row must contain digits 1–9 with no repetition.
rules.2: Each column must contain digits 1–9 with no repetition.
rules.3: Each of the nine 3×3 boxes must contain digits 1–9 with no repetition.
rules.4: Given (bold) digits are fixed — you cannot erase them.
rules.5: The puzzle is the same for everyone and resets every day.
